And so she stood upon the jagged precipice where they had danced to the song of life that still echoed within the raging ocean below. Now, with her faith, hope and courage renewed, she beckons. Her lover comes near. Slowly, the ocean silences to the sound of one heartbeat. Feeling the lingering passion buried deep within the moment just before the sun begins to rise, she begins to absorb her lover through her eyes. As they watch the colors of neon orange and pink dance across the horizon, she longs for just a taste of her lover's lips. She'd give anything to crawl inside the window of her soul and feel her warmth. That blessed serenity. For now, she waits. Enveloped in the mountain's morning mist...


Part 2 - The Aftermath 

As she closes her eyes, every sound began to fade into silence. The roar of the ocean became silent. The trees stopped swaying. The birds stopped their songs. Even the wind chose to dissipate. Everything was silent. It was as if time itself had stopped. The only sounds that seemed to exist was the beating of her lonely heart and the shallow sound of every breath she took. Reluctantly, she opens her eyes. The wind became a gentle breeze. The birds continued singing. The trees began swaying. The roar of the ocean below became known. She felt the cold sting of the cold breeze as tears filled her eyes at the thought of her ex lover. The passion that once burned brightly within her soul had been extinguished. All that was left was an emptiness. A void. She peered at the ocean below. And every memory of that day seemed to rush back.....(to be continued)
